# Author Agent Operator entry guide in learn/agentos/ routing to the one-command door (gated on #20114)

## Context

Sub-issue of `#20498` implementing **Row 8 (`agent-operator-entry`)** of the three-reader `learn/` map ([`#20498#issuecomment-6697670393`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6697670393)).

- **Ownership disposition:** `unowned-rationale: claimable leaf under #20498 gated on #20114 per map #issuecomment-6697670393 (delegated filing by @neo-fable-mnemosyne)`

## The Problem

A human who runs a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini / Antigravity) opens `"Brain Interface, Fleet & Agent Tooling"` (`learn/agentos/`) and finds 7 engine-side subsystem pages (`FleetManagerArchitecture`, `RunningTheFleetCockpit`, `NeuralLink`, `DockZoneModel`, `ProgressiveDisclosureSkills`, `CoreSkills`, `SeatMemoryLayer`) plus retained ADRs, but no **"Hand It to Your Agent" entry door**:
- There is no first page routing the operator through the one-command agent install door (`#20114`), connecting their coding agent to a live Neo.mjs app over the Neural Link, and explaining how the learning path spans the Body (`neomjs/neo/learn/agentos/`) and the Brain (`neomjs/neo-agent-brain/learn/`, tracked in `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#195` / `#202`).

Design authority: `#20498` + `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` (Row 8 `agent-operator-entry`) + `#20114` + `.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md` §0–§5.

## The Architectural Reality

- **Gate Dependency:** This leaf is gated on `#20114` (the one-command agent install surface) so the guide documents the shipped one-command workflow rather than a speculative placeholder.
- The entry guide belongs at the top of `"Brain Interface, Fleet & Agent Tooling"` in `learn/tree.json` (`learn/agentos/`) and bridges both repositories (`neomjs/neo` and `neomjs/neo-agent-brain`) plus `https://neomjs.com/llms.txt`.

## The Fix

1. Once `#20114`'s one-command install door is ready, author the Agent Operator entry guide under `learn/agentos/` (e.g. `learn/agentos/AgentQuickstart.md`) and register it as the first entry under `"Brain Interface, Fleet & Agent Tooling"` in `learn/tree.json`:
   - Show the one-command setup (`#20114`) for Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini / Antigravity.
   - Show how the agent queries `neo-mjs-knowledge-base` (`ask_knowledge_base`, `query_documents`), inspects and mutates a running app via `neo-mjs-neural-link` (`inspect_component_render_tree`, `get_instance_properties`, `patch_code`), and uses `https://neomjs.com/llms.txt` when running without local MCP servers.
   - Map the two-repository learning topology (`neomjs/neo/learn/agentos/` for the Body/Neural Link/Fleet Cockpit interface vs. `neomjs/neo-agent-brain/learn/` for Memory Core, Dream Pipeline, and Native Edge Graph).
2. Update the **Agent Operator Path** in `learn/README.md` and `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` to link this entry page first.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `learn/agentos/` + `learn/tree.json` | `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` Row 8 + `#20114` + `guide-authoring-bar.md` §0–§5 | Add Agent Operator entry guide routing to the `#20114` one-command door, Neural Link live verification, `/llms.txt`, and the Brain repository's learning path | Gated on `#20114` | `learn/agentos/*.md`, `learn/tree.json`, `learn/README.md`, `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` | Portal render check + `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` |

Decision Record impact: `aligned-with` ADR `0018` (Two Hemispheres identity).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1 (Gated on `#20114`):** Authored against the shipped `#20114` one-command install contract and verified against live MCP tool names (`neo-mjs-knowledge-base`, `neo-mjs-neural-link`, `neo-mjs-memory-core`).
- [ ] **AC-2 (Registered & Linked):** Registered as the first entry under `agentos` in `learn/tree.json` and linked from the Agent Operator path in `learn/README.md` and `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md`.
- [ ] **AC-3 (Link & Whitespace Integrity):** `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` and `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` pass with `0` errors, and `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` / `apps/portal/llms.txt` remain untouched.

## Out of Scope

Rebuilding `neomjs/neo-agent-brain/learn/` (owned by `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#195` / `#202`); hand-editing `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt`.

## Avoided Traps

- Documenting unshipped CLI flags before `#20114` lands.
- Hand-editing `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt` (`guide-authoring-bar.md` §5).
